slides.title: What to log each day, in under a minute
Your symptoms
slides.body: Which ones showed up, and how strong they felt. Mild, moderate or severe is enough.

slides.title: Sleep, mood and energy
slides.body: A rough score is fine. Over weeks, the shape matters more than any single day.

slides.title: Your period
slides.body: Whether you bled, and how heavy. Changes to periods are often one of the first signs.

slides.title: Anything that set it off
slides.body: Coffee, a glass of wine, a stressful day. Triggers are easier to spot when they're written down.

slides.title: Your medication
slides.body: What you took and when, so you can see how things change over time.

slides.title: Bring it to your appointment
slides.body: Clari turns those daily notes into a summary for your GP.
slides.source: Free on the App Store and Google Play
